title: Project-canonical semantic crosswalk between EmoHeVRDB facial expression activations and FACS

scope.recorded_api: Meta XR Core SDK Face Tracking API, version 59.0, as used for EmoHeVRDB
scope.newer_meta_sdk_note: Newer Meta SDK references include additional tongue-related expressions. They are outside the scope of this 63-channel EmoHeVRDB mapping.

interpretation.statement: The FEA values remain vendor-defined blendshape coefficients. The crosswalk provides semantic labels/groupings only; it does not convert FEA values into FACS AU occurrence or A–E intensity scores.

status_legend.direct_semantic_correspondence: The API channel name/movement directly corresponds semantically to a FACS AU or Action Descriptor, without implying measurement validation.
status_legend.component_correspondence: The API exposes a spatial component of a movement that is represented as one FACS AU.
status_legend.approximate_eye_position_correspondence: The eye-look channel is related to the same-direction FACS eye-position code, but is not treated as a calibrated gaze measurement.
status_legend.no_unique_correspondence: No unique single FACS AU/AD/eye-position code is assigned.
status_legend.no_dedicated_fea: The AU appears in the paper table but has no dedicated channel in the 63-feature schema.

paper_table_facs_2002.title: Ekman, Friesen, and Hager, Facial Action Coding System, Investigator's Guide (2002), Table 10-1
paper_table_facs_2002.role: Source of the AU/category membership reproduced in the current paper's Table 1.

meta_face_tracking_guide.title: Meta Horizon OS Developers — Face Tracking for Movement SDK for Unity
meta_face_tracking_guide.role: Meta documentation for the face-tracking/blendshape interface and FACS-based naming.

meta_ovrfaceexpressions_current.title: Meta Horizon OS Developers — OVRFaceExpressions reference (Unity SDK v205)
meta_ovrfaceexpressions_current.role: Current Meta Unity reference used to document the relationship between PascalCase OVRFaceExpressions.FaceExpression members and underscore-separated OVRPlugin.FaceExpression2 values. This is a naming/API cross-check; EmoHeVRDB itself was recorded with Meta XR Core SDK v59.

openxr_xrfaceexpressionfb.title: Khronos OpenXR — XrFaceExpressionFB
openxr_xrfaceexpressionfb.role: Authoritative 63-entry XR_FB_face_tracking enum and zero-based indices 0–62.

cohn_ambadar_ekman_2007.title: Cohn, Ambadar, and Ekman (2007), Observer-Based Measurement of Facial Expression with the Facial Action Coding System
cohn_ambadar_ekman_2007.role: FACS 2002 structure, AU/descriptor distinctions, intensity coding, eye/head position codes, and changes from FACS 1978.

callifacs_human_ad_reference.title: Correia-Caeiro et al. (2022), CalliFACS: The common marmoset Facial Action Coding System
callifacs_human_ad_reference.role: Peer-reviewed secondary cross-check listing human FACS Action Descriptors including AD29, AD30, AD34, and AD35.

cmu_facs_historical.title: CMU Facial Action Coding System reference
cmu_facs_historical.role: Historical FACS code/name cross-check, especially eye-position codes; not used as the primary source for FACS 2002 changes.

repository_cross_check.scope: Cross-checked against saved outputs in the supplied 2026-09-20 emohevrdb-dfer repository snapshot.
repository_cross_check.result: Both saved outputs show exactly 63 FEA feature columns in the same order as this mapping.
repository_cross_check.limitation: This cross-check does not re-validate all source dataset archives or the physiological accuracy of any Meta coefficient.

naming_conventions.rationale: The canonical project name matches both the EmoHeVRDB feature-column names and the public OVRFaceExpressions.FaceExpression enum member exposed by Meta's Unity API.

fea_name.meaning: Canonical short name used in EmoHeVRDB CSVs, analysis code, and mapping files.

meta_unity_member.meaning: Fully qualified public Unity FaceExpression enum member; uses PascalCase.

meta_plugin_value.meaning: Lower-level OVRPlugin.FaceExpression2 enum value referenced by the public Unity member; uses underscores.

openxr_enum.meaning: Corresponding OpenXR XrFaceExpressionFB C enum constant.

naming_conventions.usage: Use fea_name as the stable key in project data and analyses. Use the fully qualified Meta/OpenXR aliases when documenting API provenance or when matching code against the corresponding API layer.
